# GeFlow

> GeFlow is an all-in-one cloud-native Retail POS and Inventory Management platform designed for small-to-enterprise businesses, supermarkets, pharmacies, retail stores, and warehouses.

## Core Capabilities
- Point of Sale (POS): Fast transaction barcode scanning, item-level discounts, custom tax toggle, and split payment methods.
- Thermal Receipt Printing: Crisp monochrome ESC/POS compatible thermal receipts supporting 80mm & 58mm formats.
- Inventory Management: Real-time stock counts, automated low stock & out-of-stock alerts, bulk replenishment, and SKU cataloging.
- Customer Khata / Udhar Ledger: Credit accounts management with additions, repayments, and statement balance logs.
- Reporting & Audits: Verified sales ledgers, procurement cost audits, profit margins, and tax tracking.
- Team Access Control (RBAC): Owner, Manager, Cashier, and Inventory Clerk role privileges.

## Primary Routes
- `/login`: User authentication and sign-in.
- `/dashboard`: Business performance overview and quick action shortcuts.
- `/pos`: Active sales counter terminal.
- `/inventory`: Product inventory tracking and stock adjustments.
- `/reports`: Financial compliance ledger and exportable CSV/PDF statements.
- `/analytics`: Daily/weekly sales velocity trends and margin performance.
- `/team`: Staff member invites, credentials management, and access roles.
- `/settings`: Store profile, tax rates, thermal receipt templates, and alert ringtones.
